description.value: A Fraser Valley Regional District campground on the banks of the Vedder River near Chilliwack, with full amenities (flush toilets, hot showers, fire pits) and easy access to fishing, kayaking, rafting, and mountain biking; family-friendly and well-serviced but closer to suburban than wild.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Vedder River Campground is an active FVRD-operated campground at 5355 Giesbrecht Road, Chilliwack, BC. It explicitly lists hot showers, flushing toilets, fire pits, picnic tables, sani-dump, and states 'Reservations Available.' The May 2026 campfire notice confirms the campground is currently operational. No hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned. OSM record is very sparse (only name and tourism tag), with no address or phone.
concerns: OSM record is very sparse — missing address, phone, and all amenity tags
No hiker/biker-specific sites mentioned; touring cyclists would use standard campsites
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operated regional district campground in Chilliwack with tent camping, showers, and reservations — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.

wow_evidence: hot showers, flushing toilets, fire pits, picnic tables
